questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Public Transport

welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Experience With Public Transport
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your experience using public transport. Your answers help us understand barriers related to access, comfort, safety, reliability and service quality, and identify opportunities for better urban mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questionnaire.title: 5. Your Experience With Public Transport

sections.title: Getting to stops and on board
sections.description: Questions about whether you use public transport and how easy it is to reach stops and get on board.

questions.text: Do you use buses, trams, the metro or trains to get to places at least a few times a month?
Why don't you use public transport, or why do you use it so rarely? (Select all that apply)
questions.help: We ask this to understand what limits the use of public transport for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better
The stop is too far away or hard to reach
Poor service in the evening or at night
Stops or vehicles are not accessible with a wheelchair, walker or stroller
My health, a disability or my age makes it hard to use the vehicles (getting on, standing)
I don't feel safe at stops or on board
Trips take too long or need too many changes
Information on timetables and routes is hard to find or understand

questions.text: How accessible and easy to use are the public transport stops (bus, tram, metro or train) on your route? Think about steps, ramps and available space.
Which specific barriers do you face at public transport stops or when getting on and off vehicles?
questions.help: Real-time information displays are screens that show when the next vehicle is expected to arrive.

options.text: Difficulty getting on or off the vehicle (e.g., high step, ramp not working or not deployed)
Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a wheelchair, walker or stroller
Vehicles too crowded to get on with a stroller or wheelchair
No sidewalk or walkway to reach the stop
Insufficient seating or shelter at stops
I don't face any specific barrier

questions.text: How does the availability of working lifts, ramps, and step-free routes affect your ability to reach the transport stop?
questions.help: A step-free route reaches the stop or platform without any stairs or steps.

options.text: I cannot reach the stop if no accessible route exists
I need assistance from another person to reach the stop
I can reach the stop, but it requires significant physical effort
I can reach the stop independently with some difficulty
I can reach the stop easily and independently

questions.text: How does the quality of crossings (e.g., signals, bridges, or underpasses) near the stops you use most often influence your sense of safety?

options.text: I avoid some stops because the crossings feel unsafe
I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
I feel safe: the crossings are well designed and protected

sections.title: Service, comfort and delays
sections.description: Questions about how reliable the service is, how you feel on board and how delays affect you.

questions.text: During the day (from about 6 am to 8 pm), how much can you count on public transport on your usual routes arriving on time and often enough?

options.text: I don't use it at that time of day

questions.text: In the evening (after about 8 pm), how much can you count on public transport on your usual routes arriving on time and often enough?

options.text: I don't use it at that time of day

questions.text: How does crowding on buses, trams, the metro or trains make you feel during your trip?
When you use public transport, do you ever feel judged or unwelcome by other people?
questions.help: Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

questions.text: How safe from harassment or assault do you feel waiting at the stop or travelling on board in the evening?
questions.help: Harassment means unwanted comments, gestures or contact. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: I don't use public transport in the evening

questions.text: How stressful do you find unexpected delays or service disruptions during your trips?
How do delays or unreliable service typically affect your travel behavior?

options.text: I leave earlier than necessary to avoid delays
I avoid relying on public transport for important trips
I sometimes change routes or travel times
I sometimes choose another transport mode instead
I have no alternative: I wait, sometimes for a long time
I arrive late for work, school or appointments
They do not affect my behavior

sections.title: Public transport
sections.description: Questions about your experience using public transport.

questions.text: Do you use public transport for your daily travels at least once a week?
How accessible and easy to use are the public transport stops (bus, tram, or train) on your route? Think about steps, ramps and available space.
Which specific barriers did you face while using public transport stops?

options.text: Difficulty boarding or exiting the vehicle
Insufficient seating or shelter at stops
I don't face any specific barrier

questions.text: How does the presence of other people make you feel during your trip?
How does the availability of working lifts, ramps, and step-free routes affect your ability to reach the transport stop?

options.text: I cannot reach the stop if no accessible route exists
I need assistance from another person to reach the stop
I can reach the stop, but it requires significant physical effort
I can reach the stop independently with some difficulty
I can reach the stop easily and independently

questions.text: How does the quality of crossings (e.g. signals, bridges, or tunnels) near the stop influence your sense of safety?

options.text: I avoid using this stop because the crossings feel unsafe
I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
I feel safe and well protected by the crossing design and traffic controls

questions.text: How does the schedule and frequency of public transport on your route affect your ability to rely on it?

options.text: The service is so infrequent or unreliable that it does not meet my basic travel needs
I can only use it for specific trips (e.g., work or school) because it is not frequent enough for flexible daily activities
I can use it for planned trips but it's not flexible enough for unplanned travel
The service is reliable, but I need to plan my schedule around arrival and departure times
The service is frequent enough that I can use it without planning

questions.text: To what extent does using public transport affect your sense of social comfort or personal image?

options.text: I would rather not be seen using public transport
I sometimes feel uncomfortable using public transport in certain social situations
I occasionally feel out of place or self-conscious when using this service in certain social situations
I don't feel that my choice of transport has any connection to my social standing or identity
I feel comfortable and confident using this mode of transport in social settings

questions.text: How stressful do you find unexpected delays or service disruptions during your trips?
How do delays or unreliable service typically affect your travel behavior?

options.text: They do not affect my behavior
I leave earlier than necessary to avoid delays
I avoid relying on public transport for important trips
I sometimes change routes or travel times
I sometimes choose another transport mode instead

it.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - La tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico
it.#5. Your Experience With Public Transpor: 5. La tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico
it.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Benvenuto/a nel questionario sulla tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Questions about your experience usin: Domande sulla tua esperienza nell'utilizzo del trasporto pubblico.
it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity si concentra sulla tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a comprendere gli ostacoli legati ad accessibilità, comfort, sicurezza, affidabilità e qualità del servizio e a individuare opportunità per migliorare la mobilità urbana. La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#Do you use public transport for your da: Utilizzi il trasporto pubblico per i tuoi spostamenti quotidiani almeno una volta alla settimana?
it.#How accessible and easy to use are the: Quanto sono accessibili e facili da utilizzare le fermate del trasporto pubblico (autobus, tram o treno) lungo il tuo percorso? Considera scale, rampe e spazio disponibile.
it.#Which specific barriers did you face wh: Quali ostacoli specifici hai incontrato nell'utilizzo delle fermate del trasporto pubblico?
it.#Difficulty boarding or exiting the vehi: Difficoltà nel salire o scendere dal mezzo
it.#Poor accessibility for mobility needs: Scarsa accessibilità per esigenze di mobilità
it.#Lack of real-time information displays: Mancanza di display con informazioni in tempo reale
it.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Posti a sedere o ripari insufficienti alle fermate
it.#How does the presence of other people m: Come ti fa sentire la presenza di altre persone durante il viaggio?
it.#Mostly comfortable: Per lo più a mio agio
it.#How does the availability of working li: In che modo la disponibilità di ascensori funzionanti, rampe e percorsi senza gradini influisce sulla tua capacità di raggiungere la fermata?
it.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Non posso raggiungere la fermata se non esiste un percorso accessibile
it.#I need assistance from another person t: Ho bisogno dell'assistenza di un'altra persona per raggiungere la fermata
it.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Posso raggiungere la fermata, ma ciò richiede un notevole sforzo fisico
it.#I can reach the stop independently with: Posso raggiungere la fermata autonomamente, ma con qualche difficoltà
it.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Posso raggiungere la fermata facilmente e in autonomia
In che modo la qualità degli attraversamenti (ad es. semafori, ponti o sottopassaggi) vicino alla fermata influisce sulla tua percezione di sicurezza?
it.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: Evito di utilizzare questa fermata perché gli attraversamenti mi sembrano pericolosi
it.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Spesso mi sento in pericolo quando attraverso la strada per raggiungere la fermata
it.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: A volte cambio percorso per utilizzare attraversamenti che mi sembrano più sicuri
it.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: In generale mi sento al sicuro, ma devo comunque prestare attenzione quando attraverso
it.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Mi sento al sicuro e ben protetto/a dalla progettazione degli attraversamenti e dai sistemi di regolazione del traffico
it.#How does the schedule and frequency of: In che modo gli orari e la frequenza del trasporto pubblico lungo il tuo percorso influiscono sulla possibilità di farvi affidamento?
it.#The service is so infrequent or unrelia: Il servizio è così poco frequente o inaffidabile da non soddisfare le mie esigenze di mobilità di base
it.#I can only use it for specific trips (e: Posso utilizzarlo solo per spostamenti specifici (ad es. lavoro o scuola), perché non è abbastanza frequente da consentire flessibilità nelle attività quotidiane
it.#I can use it for planned trips but it's: Posso utilizzarlo per gli spostamenti pianificati, ma non è abbastanza flessibile per quelli non programmati
it.#The service is reliable, but I need to: Il servizio è affidabile, ma devo organizzare i miei impegni in base agli orari di arrivo e partenza
it.#The service is frequent enough that I c: Il servizio è abbastanza frequente da poterlo utilizzare senza pianificare in anticipo
it.#To what extent does using public transp: In che misura l'utilizzo del trasporto pubblico influisce sul tuo comfort sociale o sulla tua immagine personale?
it.#I would rather not be seen using public: Preferirei non essere visto/a mentre utilizzo il trasporto pubblico
it.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: A volte mi sento a disagio nell'utilizzare il trasporto pubblico in determinate situazioni sociali
it.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: Occasionalmente mi sento fuori posto o a disagio nell'utilizzare questo servizio in determinate situazioni sociali
it.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Non ritengo che la mia scelta del mezzo di trasporto abbia alcun legame con la mia posizione sociale o la mia identità
it.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Mi sento a mio agio e sicuro/a nell'utilizzare questa modalità di trasporto in contesti sociali
it.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: Quanto trovi stressanti i ritardi imprevisti o le interruzioni del servizio durante i tuoi spostamenti?
it.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: In che modo i ritardi o l'inaffidabilità del servizio influenzano normalmente il tuo comportamento di viaggio?
it.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: Parto prima del necessario per evitare ritardi
it.#I avoid relying on public transport for: Evito di fare affidamento sul trasporto pubblico per gli spostamenti importanti
it.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: A volte cambio percorso o orario di viaggio
it.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: A volte scelgo un'altra modalità di trasporto

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - Votre expérience des transports publics
fr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre expérience des transports publics
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Questions about your experience usin: Questions sur votre expérience des transports publics.
fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur votre expérience des transports publics. Vos réponses nous aident à comprendre les difficultés liées à l’accès, au confort, à la sécurité, à la fiabilité et à la qualité du service, et à trouver des pistes pour améliorer la mobilité urbaine. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
fr.#Do you use public transport for your da: Utilisez-vous les transports publics pour vos déplacements quotidiens au moins une fois par semaine ?
fr.#How accessible and easy to use are the: Les arrêts de transports publics de votre trajet, par exemple bus, tram ou train, sont-ils accessibles et faciles à utiliser ? Pensez aux marches, aux rampes et à l’espace disponible.
fr.#Which specific barriers did you face wh: Quels obstacles précis avez-vous rencontrés lorsque vous utilisez les arrêts de transports publics ?
fr.#Difficulty boarding or exiting the vehi: Difficulté pour monter dans le véhicule ou en descendre
fr.#Poor accessibility for mobility needs: Accès difficile pour les personnes ayant des besoins de mobilité
fr.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Pas assez de sièges ou d’abris aux arrêts
fr.#I don't face any specific barrier: Je ne rencontre aucun obstacle particulier
fr.#How does the presence of other people m: Comment la présence d’autres personnes vous fait-elle sentir pendant votre trajet ?
fr.#How does the availability of working li: Comment la présence d’ascenseurs en état de marche, de rampes et de parcours sans marches influence-t-elle votre capacité à rejoindre l’arrêt ?
fr.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Je ne peux pas atteindre l’arrêt s’il n’existe pas de parcours accessible
fr.#I need assistance from another person t: J’ai besoin de l’aide d’une autre personne pour atteindre l’arrêt
fr.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt, mais cela demande un effort physique important
fr.#I can reach the stop independently with: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt seul(e), mais avec quelques difficultés
fr.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt facilement et de façon autonome
Comment la qualité des traversées, par exemple les feux, ponts ou tunnels près de l’arrêt, influence-t-elle votre sentiment de sécurité ?
fr.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: J’évite cet arrêt parce que les traversées me semblent dangereuses
fr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Je me sens souvent en danger lorsque je traverse pour rejoindre l’arrêt
fr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Je change parfois d’itinéraire pour utiliser une traversée qui me semble plus sûre
fr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: En général, je me sens en sécurité, mais je dois rester prudent(e) lorsque je traverse
fr.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Je me sens en sécurité et bien protégé(e) grâce à l’aménagement de la traversée et à la régulation du trafic
fr.#How does the schedule and frequency of: Comment les horaires et la fréquence des transports publics sur votre trajet influencent-ils votre capacité à compter sur ce service ?
fr.#The service is so infrequent or unrelia: Le service est si peu fréquent ou peu fiable qu’il ne répond pas à mes besoins de déplacement essentiels

de.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - Ihre Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln
de.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Willkommen beim Fragebogen zu Ihrer Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#<p>Questions about your experience usin: Fragen zu Ihren Erfahrungen mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.
de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich mit Ihrer Erfahrung bei der Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel. Ihre Antworten helfen uns, Hindernisse bei Zugang, Komfort, Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Servicequalität zu verstehen und Möglichkeiten für eine bessere städtische Mobilität zu erkennen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft: Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf die verschiedenen SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#Do you use public transport for your da: Nutzen Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche öffentliche Verkehrsmittel für Ihre täglichen Wege?
de.#How accessible and easy to use are the: Wie zugänglich und einfach zu nutzen sind die Haltestellen auf Ihrer Strecke, zum Beispiel für Bus, Straßenbahn oder Zug? Denken Sie an Stufen, Rampen und verfügbaren Platz.
de.#Which specific barriers did you face wh: Welche konkreten Hindernisse erleben Sie bei der Nutzung von Haltestellen öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel?
de.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Zu wenige Sitzplätze oder fehlender Wetterschutz an Haltestellen
de.#How does the presence of other people m: Wie fühlen Sie sich durch die Anwesenheit anderer Menschen während Ihrer Fahrt?
de.#How does the availability of working li: Wie beeinflussen funktionierende Aufzüge, Rampen und stufenfreie Wege Ihre Möglichkeit, die Haltestelle zu erreichen?
de.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Ich kann die Haltestelle nicht erreichen, wenn es keinen barrierefreien Weg gibt
de.#I need assistance from another person t: Ich brauche Hilfe von einer anderen Person, um die Haltestelle zu erreichen
de.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Ich kann die Haltestelle erreichen, aber es kostet mich viel körperliche Kraft
de.#I can reach the stop independently with: Ich kann die Haltestelle selbstständig erreichen, aber nur mit einigen Schwierigkeiten
de.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Ich kann die Haltestelle leicht und selbstständig erreichen
Wie beeinflusst die Qualität von Querungen, zum Beispiel Ampeln, Brücken oder Unterführungen in der Nähe der Haltestelle, Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl?
de.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: Ich vermeide diese Haltestelle, weil sich die Querungen unsicher anfühlen
de.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Ich fühle mich beim Überqueren auf dem Weg zur Haltestelle oft unsicher
de.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Ich ändere manchmal meine Route, um eine Querung zu nutzen, die sich sicherer anfühlt
de.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Im Allgemeinen fühle ich mich sicher, muss beim Überqueren aber trotzdem vorsichtig sein
de.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Ich fühle mich durch die Gestaltung der Querung und die Verkehrsregelung sicher und gut geschützt
de.#How does the schedule and frequency of: Wie beeinflussen Fahrplan und Häufigkeit der öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel auf Ihrer Strecke, ob Sie sich darauf verlassen können?
de.#The service is so infrequent or unrelia: Das Angebot ist so selten oder unzuverlässig, dass es meine grundlegenden Mobilitätsbedürfnisse nicht erfüllt
de.#I can only use it for specific trips (e: Ich kann es nur für bestimmte Wege nutzen, zum Beispiel Arbeit oder Schule, weil es für flexible Alltagsaktivitäten nicht häufig genug fährt
de.#I can use it for planned trips but it's: Ich kann es für geplante Wege nutzen, aber für spontane Wege ist es nicht flexibel genug
de.#The service is reliable, but I need to: Das Angebot ist zuverlässig, aber ich muss meinen Tagesablauf an Ankunfts- und Abfahrtszeiten anpassen
de.#The service is frequent enough that I c: Das Angebot ist häufig genug, sodass ich es ohne große Planung nutzen kann
de.#To what extent does using public transp: Wie stark beeinflusst die Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel Ihr Wohlbefinden in sozialen Situationen oder Ihr persönliches Selbstbild?
de.#I would rather not be seen using public: Ich würde lieber nicht dabei gesehen werden, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zu nutzen
de.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: In manchen sozialen Situationen fühle ich mich bei der Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel unwohl
de.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: In manchen sozialen Situationen fühle ich mich bei der Nutzung dieses Angebots fehl am Platz oder beobachtet
de.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Ich sehe keinen Zusammenhang zwischen meiner Verkehrsmittelwahl und meinem sozialen Status oder meiner Identität
de.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Ich fühle mich wohl und sicher, wenn ich dieses Verkehrsmittel in sozialen Situationen nutze
de.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: Wie stressig finden Sie unerwartete Verspätungen oder Ausfälle während Ihrer Fahrten?
de.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: Wie beeinflussen Verspätungen oder unzuverlässiger Betrieb normalerweise Ihr Reiseverhalten?
de.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: Ich fahre früher los als nötig, um Verspätungen abzufangen
de.#I avoid relying on public transport for: Bei wichtigen Wegen verlasse ich mich lieber nicht auf öffentliche Verkehrsmittel
de.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: Ich ändere manchmal Route oder Fahrzeit
de.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: Ich wähle manchmal ein anderes Verkehrsmittel

tr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Toplu Taşıma Deneyimi Anketine Hoş Geldiniz
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Bu SmartUrbanity anketi toplu taşıma kullanma deneyiminizle ilgilidir. Yanıtlarınız erişim, konfor, güvenlik, güvenilirlik ve hizmet kalitesiyle ilgili güçlükleri anlamamıza ve daha iyi kentsel hareketlilik için iyileştirme fırsatlarını belirlememize yardımcı olur. Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez: farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtların birlikte analiz edilebilmesi için e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma adlı bir kodla saklanır.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#Do you use public transport for your da: Günlük yolculuklarınızda haftada en az bir kez toplu taşıma kullanıyor musunuz?
tr.#How accessible and easy to use are the: Güzergâhınızdaki otobüs, tramvay veya tren durakları ne kadar erişilebilir ve kullanımı ne kadar kolay? Basamakları, rampaları ve mevcut alanı düşünün.
tr.#Which specific barriers did you face wh: Toplu taşıma duraklarını kullanırken hangi belirli engellerle karşılaştınız?
tr.#Difficulty boarding or exiting the vehi: Araca binme veya araçtan inme güçlüğü
tr.#Poor accessibility for mobility needs: Hareket ihtiyacı olan kişiler için yetersiz erişilebilirlik
tr.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Duraklarda yeterli oturma alanı veya siperlik olmaması
tr.#How does the presence of other people m: Yolculuk sırasında başka insanların varlığı size nasıl hissettiriyor?
tr.#How does the availability of working li: Çalışan asansörlerin, rampaların ve basamaksız güzergâhların olması durağa ulaşma becerinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Erişilebilir bir güzergâh yoksa durağa ulaşamam
tr.#I need assistance from another person t: Durağa ulaşmak için başka bir kişinin yardımına ihtiyaç duyarım
tr.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Durağa ulaşabilirim, ancak ciddi fiziksel çaba gerektirir
tr.#I can reach the stop independently with: Durağa kendi başıma ulaşabilirim, ancak biraz zorlanırım
tr.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Durağa kolayca ve bağımsız olarak ulaşabilirim
Durağın yakınındaki geçişlerin, örneğin trafik ışıkları, köprüler veya alt geçitlerin, kalitesi güvenlik hissinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: Geçişler güvensiz hissettirdiği için bu durağı kullanmaktan kaçınırım
tr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Durağa ulaşmak için karşıya geçerken sık sık kendimi güvensiz hissederim
tr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Daha güvenli hissettiren geçişleri kullanmak için bazen güzergâhımı değiştiririm
tr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Genellikle kendimi güvende hissederim, ancak karşıya geçerken yine de dikkatli olmam gerekir
tr.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Geçiş tasarımı ve trafik düzenlemeleri sayesinde kendimi güvende ve iyi korunmuş hissederim
tr.#How does the schedule and frequency of: Güzergâhınızdaki toplu taşımanın sefer saatleri ve sıklığı, bu hizmete güvenebilmenizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#The service is so infrequent or unrelia: Hizmet o kadar seyrek veya güvenilmez ki temel ulaşım ihtiyaçlarımı karşılamıyor
tr.#I can only use it for specific trips (e: Esnek günlük işler için yeterince sık olmadığı için yalnızca iş veya okul gibi belirli yolculuklarda kullanabiliyorum
tr.#I can use it for planned trips but it's: Planlı yolculuklarda kullanabiliyorum, ancak plansız yolculuklar için yeterince esnek değil
tr.#The service is reliable, but I need to: Hizmet güvenilir, ancak programımı varış ve kalkış saatlerine göre ayarlamam gerekiyor
tr.#The service is frequent enough that I c: Hizmet yeterince sık; önceden planlama yapmadan kullanabiliyorum
tr.#To what extent does using public transp: Toplu taşıma kullanmak sosyal ortamlarda rahatlık hissinizi veya kendinizle ilgili algınızı ne ölçüde etkiler?
tr.#I would rather not be seen using public: Toplu taşıma kullanırken başkalarının beni görmemesini tercih ederim
tr.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: Bazı sosyal durumlarda toplu taşıma kullanırken kendimi rahatsız hissederim
tr.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: Bazı sosyal durumlarda bu hizmeti kullanırken kendimi ait değilmiş veya fazla dikkat çekiyormuş gibi hissederim
tr.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Ulaşım tercihim ile sosyal statüm veya kimliğim arasında bir bağlantı olduğunu düşünmüyorum
tr.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Sosyal ortamlarda bu ulaşım seçeneğini kullanırken kendimi rahat ve güvende hissederim
tr.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: Yolculuklarınız sırasında beklenmedik gecikmeleri veya hizmet kesintilerini ne kadar stresli buluyorsunuz?
tr.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: Gecikmeler veya hizmetin güvenilir olmaması yolculuk davranışınızı genellikle nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: Gecikmelerden kaçınmak için gerekenden daha erken çıkarım
tr.#I avoid relying on public transport for: Önemli yolculuklarda toplu taşımaya güvenmekten kaçınırım
tr.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: Bazen güzergâhımı veya yolculuk saatimi değiştiririm
tr.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: Bazen bunun yerine başka bir ulaşım seçeneği kullanırım

fa.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - تجربه شما از حمل‌ونقل عمومی
fa.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: به پرسشنامه تجربه حمل‌ونقل عمومی خوش آمدید
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>Questions about your experience usin: سؤال‌هایی درباره تجربه شما از استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی.
fa.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
این پرسشنامه SmartUrbanity درباره تجربه شما از استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی است. پاسخ‌های شما به ما کمک می‌کند مشکلات مربوط به دسترسی، راحتی، ایمنی، قابل اعتماد بودن و کیفیت خدمات را بهتر بفهمیم و فرصت‌های بهبود جابه‌جایی شهری را شناسایی کنیم. شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود: پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما ساخته می‌شود ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید
fa.#Do you use public transport for your da: آیا حداقل هفته‌ای یک بار برای رفت‌وآمد روزانه از حمل‌ونقل عمومی استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#How accessible and easy to use are the: ایستگاه‌های حمل‌ونقل عمومی در مسیر شما، مانند اتوبوس، تراموا یا قطار، چقدر دسترس‌پذیر و استفاده از آن‌ها چقدر آسان است؟ پله، رمپ و فضای موجود را در نظر بگیرید.
fa.#Which specific barriers did you face wh: هنگام استفاده از ایستگاه‌های حمل‌ونقل عمومی با چه موانع مشخصی روبه‌رو شده‌اید؟
fa.#Difficulty boarding or exiting the vehi: دشواری در سوار یا پیاده شدن از وسیله
fa.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: کمبود صندلی یا سرپناه در ایستگاه
fa.#How does the presence of other people m: حضور افراد دیگر در طول سفر چه احساسی در شما ایجاد می‌کند؟
fa.#How does the availability of working li: وجود آسانسور سالم، رمپ و مسیر بدون پله چه اثری بر توانایی شما برای رسیدن به ایستگاه دارد؟
fa.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: اگر مسیر دسترس‌پذیر وجود نداشته باشد، نمی‌توانم به ایستگاه برسم
fa.#I need assistance from another person t: برای رسیدن به ایستگاه به کمک فرد دیگری نیاز دارم
fa.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: می‌توانم به ایستگاه برسم، اما تلاش جسمی زیادی لازم است
fa.#I can reach the stop independently with: می‌توانم مستقل به ایستگاه برسم، اما با کمی دشواری
fa.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: می‌توانم به‌راحتی و مستقل به ایستگاه برسم
کیفیت گذرگاه‌ها، مانند چراغ، پل یا زیرگذر نزدیک ایستگاه، چه اثری بر احساس امنیت شما دارد؟
fa.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: به دلیل ناامن بودن گذرگاه‌ها از این ایستگاه استفاده نمی‌کنم
fa.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: هنگام عبور برای رسیدن به ایستگاه اغلب احساس ناامنی می‌کنم
fa.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: گاهی مسیرم را تغییر می‌دهم تا از گذرگاهی استفاده کنم که امن‌تر به نظر می‌رسد
fa.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: در مجموع احساس امنیت می‌کنم، اما هنگام عبور همچنان باید مراقب باشم
fa.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: به دلیل طراحی گذرگاه و کنترل ترافیک احساس امنیت و محافظت خوبی دارم
fa.#How does the schedule and frequency of: برنامه زمانی و تعداد سرویس‌های حمل‌ونقل عمومی در مسیر شما چگونه بر قابل اتکا بودن آن اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#The service is so infrequent or unrelia: سرویس آن‌قدر کم یا نامطمئن است که نیازهای اصلی رفت‌وآمد مرا برآورده نمی‌کند
fa.#I can only use it for specific trips (e: فقط برای سفرهای مشخص مانند کار یا مدرسه می‌توانم از آن استفاده کنم، چون برای کارهای روزمره انعطاف‌پذیر به اندازه کافی پرتکرار نیست
fa.#I can use it for planned trips but it's: برای سفرهای برنامه‌ریزی‌شده می‌توانم استفاده کنم، اما برای سفرهای ناگهانی انعطاف کافی ندارد
fa.#The service is reliable, but I need to: سرویس قابل اعتماد است، اما باید برنامه روزانه‌ام را با زمان ورود و حرکت هماهنگ کنم
fa.#The service is frequent enough that I c: سرویس به اندازه کافی پرتکرار است و می‌توانم بدون برنامه‌ریزی زیاد از آن استفاده کنم
fa.#To what extent does using public transp: استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی تا چه اندازه بر احساس راحتی شما در موقعیت‌های اجتماعی یا برداشت شما از خودتان اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#I would rather not be seen using public: ترجیح می‌دهم دیگران مرا هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی نبینند
fa.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: در بعضی موقعیت‌های اجتماعی هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی احساس ناراحتی می‌کنم
fa.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: در بعضی موقعیت‌های اجتماعی هنگام استفاده از این سرویس احساس می‌کنم به آن محیط تعلق ندارم یا بیش از حد مورد توجه هستم
fa.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: فکر نمی‌کنم انتخاب وسیله رفت‌وآمد من ارتباطی با جایگاه اجتماعی یا هویتم داشته باشد
fa.#I feel comfortable and confident using: در موقعیت‌های اجتماعی هنگام استفاده از این روش رفت‌وآمد احساس راحتی و اطمینان می‌کنم
fa.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: تأخیرهای غیرمنتظره یا اختلال در سرویس در طول سفر چقدر برای شما استرس‌زا است؟
fa.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: تأخیر یا قابل اعتماد نبودن سرویس معمولاً چگونه رفتار سفر شما را تغییر می‌دهد؟
fa.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: برای جلوگیری از دیر رسیدن، زودتر از زمان لازم حرکت می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid relying on public transport for: برای سفرهای مهم ترجیح می‌دهم به حمل‌ونقل عمومی تکیه نکنم
fa.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: گاهی مسیر یا زمان سفر را تغییر می‌دهم

hu.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Üdvözöljük a tömegközlekedési tapasztalatokról szóló kérdőívben
hu.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Válaszát rögzítettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt a kérdőív kitöltésére.
hu.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ez a SmartUrbanity kérdőív a tömegközlekedés használatával kapcsolatos tapasztalatairól szól. Válaszai segítenek megérteni a hozzáféréssel, kényelemmel, biztonsággal, megbízhatósággal és szolgáltatásminőséggel kapcsolatos nehézségeket, és feltárni a városi közlekedés fejlesztési lehetőségeit. A részvétel önkéntes. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez: egy, az e-mail-címéből képzett álnevesített kóddal tároljuk őket, hogy a különböző SmartUrbanity-kérdőívekre adott válaszait együtt lehessen elemezni.

This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your experience using public transport. Your answers help us understand barriers related to access, comfort, safety, reliability and service quality, and identify opportunities for better urban mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

":"

Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur votre expérience des transports publics. Vos réponses nous aident à comprendre les difficultés liées à l’accès, au confort, à la sécurité, à la fiabilité et à la qualité du service, et à trouver des pistes pour améliorer la mobilité urbaine. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Experience With Public Transport
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your experience using public transport. Your answers help us understand barriers related to access, comfort, safety, reliability and service quality, and identify opportunities for better urban mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

questionnaire.title: 5. Your Experience With Public Transport

sections.title: Getting to stops and on board
sections.description: Questions about whether you use public transport and how easy it is to reach stops and get on board.

questions.text: Do you use buses, trams, the metro or trains to get to places at least a few times a month?
Why don't you use public transport, or why do you use it so rarely? (Select all that apply)
questions.help: We ask this to understand what limits the use of public transport for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better
The stop is too far away or hard to reach
Poor service in the evening or at night
Stops or vehicles are not accessible with a wheelchair, walker or stroller
My health, a disability or my age makes it hard to use the vehicles (getting on, standing)
I don't feel safe at stops or on board
Trips take too long or need too many changes
Information on timetables and routes is hard to find or understand

questions.text: How accessible and easy to use are the public transport stops (bus, tram, metro or train) on your route? Think about steps, ramps and available space.
Which specific barriers do you face at public transport stops or when getting on and off vehicles?
questions.help: Real-time information displays are screens that show when the next vehicle is expected to arrive.

options.text: Difficulty getting on or off the vehicle (e.g., high step, ramp not working or not deployed)
Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a wheelchair, walker or stroller
Vehicles too crowded to get on with a stroller or wheelchair
No sidewalk or walkway to reach the stop
Insufficient seating or shelter at stops
I don't face any specific barrier

questions.text: How does the availability of working lifts, ramps, and step-free routes affect your ability to reach the transport stop?
questions.help: A step-free route reaches the stop or platform without any stairs or steps.

options.text: I cannot reach the stop if no accessible route exists
I need assistance from another person to reach the stop
I can reach the stop, but it requires significant physical effort
I can reach the stop independently with some difficulty
I can reach the stop easily and independently

questions.text: How does the quality of crossings (e.g., signals, bridges, or underpasses) near the stops you use most often influence your sense of safety?

options.text: I avoid some stops because the crossings feel unsafe
I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
I feel safe: the crossings are well designed and protected

sections.title: Service, comfort and delays
sections.description: Questions about how reliable the service is, how you feel on board and how delays affect you.

questions.text: During the day (from about 6 am to 8 pm), how much can you count on public transport on your usual routes arriving on time and often enough?

questions.text: In the evening (after about 8 pm), how much can you count on public transport on your usual routes arriving on time and often enough?

options.text: I don't use it at that time of day

questions.text: How does crowding on buses, trams, the metro or trains make you feel during your trip?

it.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - La tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico
it.#5. Your Experience With Public Transpor: 5. La tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico
it.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Benvenuto/a nel questionario sulla tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#Getting to stops and on board: Raggiungere le fermate e salire a bordo
it.#<p>Questions about whether you use publ: Domande sull'uso del trasporto pubblico e su quanto è facile raggiungere le fermate e salire a bordo.
it.#Difficulty getting on or off the vehicl: Difficoltà nel salire o scendere dal mezzo (ad es. gradino alto, pedana o rampa non funzionante o non aperta)
it.#Lack of real-time information displays: Mancanza di display con informazioni in tempo reale
it.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Posti a sedere o ripari insufficienti alle fermate
it.#Mostly comfortable: Per lo più a mio agio
it.#How does the availability of working li: In che modo la disponibilità di ascensori funzionanti, rampe e percorsi senza gradini influisce sulla tua capacità di raggiungere la fermata?
it.#A step-free route reaches the stop or p: Un percorso senza gradini porta alla fermata o al binario senza scale né scalini.
it.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Non posso raggiungere la fermata se non esiste un percorso accessibile
it.#I need assistance from another person t: Ho bisogno dell'assistenza di un'altra persona per raggiungere la fermata
it.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Posso raggiungere la fermata, ma ciò richiede un notevole sforzo fisico
it.#I can reach the stop independently with: Posso raggiungere la fermata autonomamente, ma con qualche difficoltà
it.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Posso raggiungere la fermata facilmente e in autonomia

it.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: A volte cambio percorso per utilizzare attraversamenti che mi sembrano più sicuri
it.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: In generale mi sento al sicuro, ma devo comunque prestare attenzione quando attraverso
it.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: Quanto trovi stressanti i ritardi imprevisti o le interruzioni del servizio durante i tuoi spostamenti?
it.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: In che modo i ritardi o l'inaffidabilità del servizio influenzano normalmente il tuo modo di spostarti?
it.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: Parto prima del necessario per evitare ritardi
it.#I avoid relying on public transport for: Evito di fare affidamento sul trasporto pubblico per gli spostamenti importanti
it.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: A volte cambio percorso o orario dello spostamento
it.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: A volte scelgo un'altra modalità di trasporto
it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity si concentra sulla tua esperienza con il trasporto pubblico. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a comprendere gli ostacoli legati ad accessibilità, comfort, sicurezza, affidabilità e qualità del servizio e a individuare opportunità per migliorare la mobilità urbana. La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - Votre expérience des transports publics
fr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre expérience des transports publics
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#Getting to stops and on board: Accéder aux arrêts et monter à bord
fr.#<p>Questions about whether you use publ: Questions pour savoir si vous utilisez les transports en commun et s'il est facile d'accéder aux arrêts et de monter à bord.
fr.#Difficulty getting on or off the vehicl: Difficulté pour monter dans le véhicule ou en descendre (par ex. marche haute, rampe en panne ou non déployée)
fr.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Pas assez de sièges ou d’abris aux arrêts
fr.#I don't face any specific barrier: Je ne rencontre aucun obstacle particulier
fr.#How does the availability of working li: Comment la présence d’ascenseurs en état de marche, de rampes et de parcours sans marches influence-t-elle votre capacité à rejoindre l’arrêt ?
fr.#A step-free route reaches the stop or p: Un parcours sans marches permet d'atteindre l'arrêt ou le quai sans escalier ni marche.
fr.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Je ne peux pas atteindre l’arrêt s’il n’existe pas de parcours accessible
fr.#I need assistance from another person t: J’ai besoin de l’aide d’une autre personne pour atteindre l’arrêt
fr.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt, mais cela demande un effort physique important
fr.#I can reach the stop independently with: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt seul(e), mais avec quelques difficultés
fr.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Je peux atteindre l’arrêt facilement et de façon autonome
fr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Je me sens souvent en danger lorsque je traverse pour rejoindre l’arrêt
fr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Je change parfois d’itinéraire pour utiliser une traversée qui me semble plus sûre
fr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: En général, je me sens en sécurité, mais je dois rester prudent(e) lorsque je traverse
fr.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: À quel point les retards imprévus ou les interruptions de service sont-ils stressants pendant vos trajets ?
fr.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: Comment les retards ou le manque de fiabilité du service influencent-ils généralement votre façon de vous déplacer ?
fr.#They do not affect my behavior: Ils n’influencent pas ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: Je pars plus tôt que nécessaire pour éviter les retards
fr.#I avoid relying on public transport for: J’évite de compter sur les transports publics pour les trajets importants
fr.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: Je change parfois d’itinéraire ou d’heure de déplacement
fr.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: Je choisis parfois un autre mode de transport
fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur votre expérience des transports publics. Vos réponses nous aident à comprendre les difficultés liées à l’accès, au confort, à la sécurité, à la fiabilité et à la qualité du service, et à trouver des pistes pour améliorer la mobilité urbaine. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

fr.#During the day (from about 6 am to 8 pm: En journée (de 6 h à 20 h environ), dans quelle mesure pouvez-vous compter sur des transports en commun à l'heure et assez fréquents sur vos trajets habituels ?
fr.#I don't use it at that time of day: Je ne les utilise pas à ce moment de la journée
fr.#In the evening (after about 8 pm), how: Le soir (après 20 h environ), dans quelle mesure pouvez-vous compter sur des transports en commun à l'heure et assez fréquents sur vos trajets habituels ?
fr.#When you use public transport, do you e: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, vous arrive-t-il de vous sentir jugé(e) ou mal accueilli(e) par d'autres personnes ?
fr.#Answering is optional, and you can also: Répondre est facultatif, et vous pouvez aussi choisir de ne pas le dire.
fr.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Je n'ai pas d'alternative : j'attends, parfois longtemps
fr.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: J'arrive en retard au travail, à l'école ou à mes rendez-vous
fr.#<p>Questions about how reliable the ser: Questions sur la fiabilité du service, ce que vous ressentez à bord et l'effet des retards sur vous.
fr.#How safe from harassment or assault do: À quel point vous sentez-vous à l'abri du harcèlement ou d'une agression en attendant à l'arrêt ou à bord le soir ?
fr.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Le harcèlement désigne des commentaires, gestes ou contacts non désirés. Répondre est facultatif et votre réponse n'est pas liée à votre nom.
fr.#Neither safe nor unsafe: Ni en sécurité ni en insécurité
fr.#I don't use public transport in the eve: Je n'utilise pas les transports publics le soir

de.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - Ihre Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln
de.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Willkommen beim Fragebogen zu Ihrer Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#Getting to stops and on board: Zur Haltestelle und in das Fahrzeug
de.#<p>Questions about whether you use publ: Fragen dazu, ob Sie öffentliche Verkehrsmittel nutzen und wie leicht Sie Haltestellen erreichen und einsteigen können.
de.#Difficulty getting on or off the vehicl: Schwierigkeiten beim Ein- oder Aussteigen (z. B. hohe Stufe, Rampe defekt oder nicht ausgeklappt)
de.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Zu wenige Sitzplätze oder fehlender Wetterschutz an Haltestellen
de.#How does the availability of working li: Wie beeinflussen funktionierende Aufzüge, Rampen und stufenfreie Wege Ihre Möglichkeit, die Haltestelle zu erreichen?
de.#A step-free route reaches the stop or p: Ein stufenfreier Weg führt ohne Treppen oder Stufen zur Haltestelle oder zum Bahnsteig.
de.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Ich kann die Haltestelle nicht erreichen, wenn es keinen barrierefreien Weg gibt
de.#I need assistance from another person t: Ich brauche Hilfe von einer anderen Person, um die Haltestelle zu erreichen
de.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Ich kann die Haltestelle erreichen, aber es kostet mich viel körperliche Kraft
de.#I can reach the stop independently with: Ich kann die Haltestelle selbstständig erreichen, aber nur mit einigen Schwierigkeiten
de.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Ich kann die Haltestelle leicht und selbstständig erreichen
de.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Ich fühle mich beim Überqueren auf dem Weg zur Haltestelle oft unsicher
de.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Ich ändere manchmal meine Route, um eine Querung zu nutzen, die sich sicherer anfühlt
de.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Im Allgemeinen fühle ich mich sicher, muss beim Überqueren aber trotzdem vorsichtig sein
de.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: Wie stressig finden Sie unerwartete Verspätungen oder Ausfälle während Ihrer Fahrten?
de.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: Wie beeinflussen Verspätungen oder unzuverlässiger Betrieb normalerweise Ihr Reiseverhalten?
de.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: Ich fahre früher los als nötig, um Verspätungen abzufangen
de.#I avoid relying on public transport for: Bei wichtigen Wegen verlasse ich mich lieber nicht auf öffentliche Verkehrsmittel
de.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: Ich ändere manchmal Route oder Fahrzeit
de.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: Ich wähle manchmal ein anderes Verkehrsmittel
de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich mit Ihrer Erfahrung bei der Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel. Ihre Antworten helfen uns, Hindernisse bei Zugang, Komfort, Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Servicequalität zu verstehen und Möglichkeiten für eine bessere städtische Mobilität zu erkennen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft: Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf die verschiedenen SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren
de.#Do you use buses, trams, the metro or t: Nutzen Sie Busse, Straßenbahnen, U-Bahn oder Züge mindestens ein paar Mal im Monat, um irgendwohin zu gelangen?
de.#Why don't you use public transport, or: Warum nutzen Sie öffentliche Verkehrsmittel nicht oder so selten? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, was die Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel für verschiedene Menschen einschränkt. Die Antwort ist freiwillig, und Sie können auch angeben, dass Sie es lieber nicht sagen möchten.
de.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: Die Haltestelle ist zu weit entfernt oder schwer zu erreichen
de.#Services are infrequent or unreliable: Die Verbindungen sind selten oder unzuverlässig
de.#Poor service in the evening or at night: Schlechtes Angebot am Abend oder in der Nacht
de.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: Haltestellen oder Fahrzeuge sind mit Rollstuhl, Rollator oder Kinderwagen nicht zugänglich
de.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Meine Gesundheit, eine Behinderung oder mein Alter erschweren mir die Nutzung der Fahrzeuge (Einsteigen, Stehen)
de.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: Ich fühle mich an Haltestellen oder im Fahrzeug nicht sicher
de.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: Die Fahrten dauern zu lange oder erfordern zu viele Umstiege
de.#Information on timetables and routes is: Informationen zu Fahrplänen und Linien sind schwer zu finden oder zu verstehen
de.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Ich brauche es nicht: Andere Fortbewegungsarten passen besser zu mir
de.#How accessible and easy to use are the: Wie zugänglich und einfach zu nutzen sind die Haltestellen auf Ihrer Strecke, zum Beispiel für Bus, Straßenbahn, U-Bahn oder Zug? Denken Sie an Stufen, Rampen und verfügbaren Platz.
de.#Which specific barriers do you face at: Auf welche konkreten Hindernisse stoßen Sie an Haltestellen oder beim Ein- und Aussteigen?
de.#Real-time information displays are scre: Echtzeit-Anzeigen sind Bildschirme, die zeigen, wann das nächste Fahrzeug voraussichtlich ankommt.
de.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: Haltestelle oder Fahrzeug mit Rollstuhl, Rollator oder Kinderwagen nicht nutzbar
de.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: Fahrzeuge zu voll, um mit Kinderwagen oder Rollstuhl einzusteigen
de.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: Kein Gehweg oder Fußweg zur Haltestelle
de.#How does crowding on buses, trams, the: Wie fühlen Sie sich, wenn Busse, Straßenbahnen, U-Bahnen oder Züge während Ihrer Fahrt überfüllt sind?
Wie beeinflusst die Qualität der Übergänge (z. B. Ampeln, Brücken oder Unterführungen) in der Nähe der Haltestellen, die Sie am häufigsten nutzen, Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl?
de.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: Ich meide manche Haltestellen, weil mir die Übergänge unsicher erscheinen
de.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: Ich fühle mich sicher: Die Übergänge sind gut gestaltet und geschützt
de.#During the day (from about 6 am to 8 pm: Wie sehr können Sie sich tagsüber (etwa von 6 bis 20 Uhr) darauf verlassen, dass die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel auf Ihren üblichen Strecken pünktlich und oft genug fahren?
de.#I don't use it at that time of day: Ich nutze sie zu dieser Tageszeit nicht
de.#In the evening (after about 8 pm), how: Wie sehr können Sie sich abends (nach etwa 20 Uhr) darauf verlassen, dass die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel auf Ihren üblichen Strecken pünktlich und oft genug fahren?
de.#When you use public transport, do you e: Kommt es vor, dass Sie sich bei der Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel von anderen Menschen beurteilt oder nicht willkommen fühlen?
de.#Answering is optional, and you can also: Die Antwort ist freiwillig, und Sie können auch angeben, dass Sie es lieber nicht sagen möchten.
de.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Ich habe keine Alternative: Ich warte, manchmal lange
de.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: Ich komme zu spät zur Arbeit, zur Schule oder zu Terminen
de.#<p>Questions about how reliable the ser: Fragen dazu, wie zuverlässig das Angebot ist, wie Sie sich im Fahrzeug fühlen und wie Verspätungen Sie betreffen.
de.#How safe from harassment or assault do: Wie sicher vor Belästigung oder Übergriffen fühlen Sie sich abends beim Warten an der Haltestelle oder während der Fahrt?
de.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Belästigung bedeutet unerwünschte Bemerkungen, Gesten oder Berührungen. Die Antwort ist freiwillig und nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.
de.#I don't use public transport in the eve: Abends nutze ich keine öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel

tr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: Toplu Taşıma Deneyimi Anketine Hoş Geldiniz
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>Questions about whether you use publ: Toplu taşıma kullanıp kullanmadığınız ve duraklara ulaşmanın ve araca binmenin ne kadar kolay olduğu hakkında sorular.
tr.#Difficulty getting on or off the vehicl: Araca binme veya araçtan inme güçlüğü (ör. yüksek basamak, rampanın çalışmaması veya açılmaması)
tr.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: Duraklarda yeterli oturma alanı veya siperlik olmaması
tr.#How does the availability of working li: Çalışan asansörlerin, rampaların ve basamaksız güzergâhların olması durağa ulaşma becerinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#A step-free route reaches the stop or p: Basamaksız güzergâh, durağa ya da perona hiç merdiven veya basamak olmadan ulaşan yoldur.
tr.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: Erişilebilir bir güzergâh yoksa durağa ulaşamam
tr.#I need assistance from another person t: Durağa ulaşmak için başka bir kişinin yardımına ihtiyaç duyarım
tr.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: Durağa ulaşabilirim, ancak ciddi fiziksel çaba gerektirir
tr.#I can reach the stop independently with: Durağa kendi başıma ulaşabilirim, ancak biraz zorlanırım
tr.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: Durağa kolayca ve bağımsız olarak ulaşabilirim
tr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Durağa ulaşmak için karşıya geçerken sık sık kendimi güvensiz hissederim
tr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Daha güvenli hissettiren geçişleri kullanmak için bazen güzergâhımı değiştiririm
tr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Genellikle kendimi güvende hissederim, ancak karşıya geçerken yine de dikkatli olmam gerekir
tr.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: Yolculuklarınız sırasında beklenmedik gecikmeleri veya hizmet kesintilerini ne kadar stresli buluyorsunuz?
tr.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: Gecikmeler veya hizmetin güvenilir olmaması yolculuk davranışınızı genellikle nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: Gecikmelerden kaçınmak için gerekenden daha erken çıkarım
tr.#I avoid relying on public transport for: Önemli yolculuklarda toplu taşımaya güvenmekten kaçınırım
tr.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: Bazen güzergâhımı veya yolculuk saatimi değiştiririm
tr.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: Bazen bunun yerine başka bir ulaşım seçeneği kullanırım
tr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Bu SmartUrbanity anketi toplu taşıma kullanma deneyiminizle ilgilidir. Yanıtlarınız erişim, konfor, güvenlik, güvenilirlik ve hizmet kalitesiyle ilgili güçlükleri anlamamıza ve daha iyi kentsel hareketlilik için iyileştirme fırsatlarını belirlememize yardımcı olur. Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez: farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtların birlikte analiz edilebilmesi için e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma adlı bir kodla saklanır.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#Do you use buses, trams, the metro or t: Bir yerlere gitmek için ayda en az birkaç kez otobüs, tramvay, metro veya tren kullanıyor musunuz?
tr.#Why don't you use public transport, or: Toplu taşımayı neden kullanmıyorsunuz ya da neden bu kadar az kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#We ask this to understand what limits t: Bunu, farklı kişiler için toplu taşıma kullanımını neyin sınırladığını anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#The stop is too far away or hard to rea: Durak çok uzak veya ulaşması zor
tr.#Stops or vehicles are not accessible wi: Duraklar veya araçlar tekerlekli sandalye, yürüteç ya da bebek arabasıyla erişilebilir değil
tr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Sağlığım, bir engelim veya yaşım araçları kullanmamı zorlaştırıyor (binmek, ayakta durmak)
tr.#I don't feel safe at stops or on board: Duraklarda veya araçta kendimi güvende hissetmiyorum
tr.#Trips take too long or need too many ch: Yolculuklar çok uzun sürüyor veya çok fazla aktarma gerektiriyor
tr.#Information on timetables and routes is: Sefer saatleri ve güzergâhlarla ilgili bilgileri bulmak veya anlamak zor
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun
tr.#How accessible and easy to use are the: Güzergâhınızdaki otobüs, tramvay, metro veya tren durakları ne kadar erişilebilir ve kullanımı ne kadar kolay? Basamakları, rampaları ve mevcut alanı düşünün.
tr.#Which specific barriers do you face at: Toplu taşıma duraklarında veya araçlara binip inerken hangi belirli engellerle karşılaşıyorsunuz?
tr.#Real-time information displays are scre: Gerçek zamanlı bilgi ekranları, bir sonraki aracın ne zaman gelmesinin beklendiğini gösteren ekranlardır.
tr.#Stop or vehicle cannot be used with a w: Durak veya araç tekerlekli sandalye, yürüteç ya da bebek arabasıyla kullanılamıyor
tr.#Vehicles too crowded to get on with a s: Araçlar bebek arabası veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle binilemeyecek kadar kalabalık
tr.#No sidewalk or walkway to reach the sto: Durağa ulaşmak için kaldırım veya yaya yolu yok
tr.#How does crowding on buses, trams, the: Yolculuğunuz sırasında otobüs, tramvay, metro veya trenlerin kalabalık olması size nasıl hissettiriyor?
En sık kullandığınız durakların yakınındaki geçitlerin (ör. trafik ışıkları, üst geçitler veya alt geçitler) kalitesi güvenlik hissinizi nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#I avoid some stops because the crossing: Geçitler güvensiz geldiği için bazı duraklardan kaçınıyorum
tr.#I feel safe: the crossings are well des: Kendimi güvende hissediyorum: geçitler iyi tasarlanmış ve korunaklı
tr.#During the day (from about 6 am to 8 pm: Gündüz (yaklaşık saat 06.00 ile 20.00 arası), alışık olduğunuz güzergâhlarda toplu taşımanın zamanında ve yeterince sık gelmesine ne kadar güvenebiliyorsunuz?
tr.#In the evening (after about 8 pm), how: Akşam (yaklaşık saat 20.00'den sonra), alışık olduğunuz güzergâhlarda toplu taşımanın zamanında ve yeterince sık gelmesine ne kadar güvenebiliyorsunuz?
tr.#When you use public transport, do you e: Toplu taşıma kullanırken başkaları tarafından yargılandığınızı ya da istenmediğinizi hissettiğiniz oluyor mu?
tr.#Answering is optional, and you can also: Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Başka seçeneğim yok: bazen uzun süre bekliyorum
tr.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: İşe, okula veya randevulara geç kalıyorum
tr.#<p>Questions about how reliable the ser: Hizmetin ne kadar güvenilir olduğu, araçta nasıl hissettiğiniz ve gecikmelerin sizi nasıl etkilediği hakkında sorular.
tr.#How safe from harassment or assault do: Akşamları durakta beklerken veya araçta yolculuk ederken tacize ya da saldırıya karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Taciz, istenmeyen söz, hareket veya temas anlamına gelir. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır ve yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.

fa.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Pu: SmartUrbanity - تجربه شما از حمل‌ونقل عمومی
fa.#Welcome to Your Experience With Public: به پرسشنامه تجربه حمل‌ونقل عمومی خوش آمدید
fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#Getting to stops and on board: رسیدن به ایستگاه و سوار شدن
fa.#<p>Questions about whether you use publ: پرسش‌هایی دربارهٔ اینکه آیا از حمل‌ونقل عمومی استفاده می‌کنید و رسیدن به ایستگاه و سوار شدن چقدر آسان است.
fa.#Difficulty getting on or off the vehicl: دشواری در سوار یا پیاده شدن از وسیله (مثلاً پلهٔ بلند، رمپی که کار نمی‌کند یا باز نمی‌شود)
fa.#Insufficient seating or shelter at stop: کمبود صندلی یا سرپناه در ایستگاه
fa.#How does the availability of working li: وجود آسانسور سالم، رمپ و مسیر بدون پله چه اثری بر توانایی شما برای رسیدن به ایستگاه دارد؟
fa.#A step-free route reaches the stop or p: مسیر بدون پله بدون هیچ پله‌ای به ایستگاه یا سکو می‌رسد.
fa.#I cannot reach the stop if no accessibl: اگر مسیر دسترس‌پذیر وجود نداشته باشد، نمی‌توانم به ایستگاه برسم
fa.#I need assistance from another person t: برای رسیدن به ایستگاه به کمک فرد دیگری نیاز دارم
fa.#I can reach the stop, but it requires s: می‌توانم به ایستگاه برسم، اما تلاش جسمی زیادی لازم است
fa.#I can reach the stop independently with: می‌توانم مستقل به ایستگاه برسم، اما با کمی دشواری
fa.#I can reach the stop easily and indepen: می‌توانم به‌راحتی و مستقل به ایستگاه برسم
fa.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: هنگام عبور برای رسیدن به ایستگاه اغلب احساس ناامنی می‌کنم
fa.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: گاهی مسیرم را تغییر می‌دهم تا از گذرگاهی استفاده کنم که امن‌تر به نظر می‌رسد
fa.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: در مجموع احساس امنیت می‌کنم، اما هنگام عبور همچنان باید مراقب باشم
fa.#How stressful do you find unexpected de: تأخیرهای غیرمنتظره یا اختلال در سرویس در طول سفر چقدر برای شما استرس‌زا است؟
fa.#How do delays or unreliable service typ: تأخیر یا قابل اعتماد نبودن سرویس معمولاً چگونه رفتار سفر شما را تغییر می‌دهد؟
fa.#I leave earlier than necessary to avoid: برای جلوگیری از دیر رسیدن، زودتر از زمان لازم حرکت می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid relying on public transport for: برای سفرهای مهم ترجیح می‌دهم به حمل‌ونقل عمومی تکیه نکنم
fa.#I sometimes change routes or travel tim: گاهی مسیر یا زمان سفر را تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#I sometimes choose another transport mo: گاهی به جای آن روش دیگری را انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
این پرسشنامه SmartUrbanity درباره تجربه شما از استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی است. پاسخ‌های شما به ما کمک می‌کند مشکلات مربوط به دسترسی، راحتی، ایمنی، قابل اعتماد بودن و کیفیت خدمات را بهتر بفهمیم و فرصت‌های بهبود جابه‌جایی شهری را شناسایی کنیم. شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود: پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما ساخته می‌شود ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

درباره SmartUrbanity بیشتر بدانید
fa.#Do you use buses, trams, the metro or t: آیا دست‌کم چند بار در ماه برای رفت‌وآمد از اتوبوس، تراموا، مترو یا قطار استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#Why don't you use public transport, or: چرا از حمل‌ونقل عمومی استفاده نمی‌کنید یا چرا این‌قدر کم از آن استفاده می‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)

hu.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ez a SmartUrbanity kérdőív a tömegközlekedés használatával kapcsolatos tapasztalatairól szól. Válaszai segítenek megérteni a hozzáféréssel, kényelemmel, biztonsággal, megbízhatósággal és szolgáltatásminőséggel kapcsolatos nehézségeket, és feltárni a városi közlekedés fejlesztési lehetőségeit. A részvétel önkéntes. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez: egy, az e-mail-címéből képzett álnevesített kóddal tároljuk őket, hogy a különböző SmartUrbanity-kérdőívekre adott válaszait együtt lehessen elemezni.
